$description: WordPress theme typography for Bold Coastal: heading, body and small-headline families and the eyebrow. Generated from the Figma "Typography Theme" collection (mode Bold Coastal); never edit by hand.

heading-family.$description: Which font family headlines use, per shared theme. Confirmed live 2026-08-27: Measured Vibrant & Bold Coastal use Noto Serif; Modern Earthy & Morning Call use Noto Sans (the reverse pairing). Denver Post (bespoke, not a shared theme) also confirmed Noto Serif, matching the Measured Vibrant/Bold Coastal cluster.

body-family.$description: Which font family body copy uses, per shared theme — always the opposite of font/theme/heading-family within a theme. Confirmed live 2026-08-27.

eyebrow-size.$description:
Eyebrow/module-header label size, per brand theme. Added 2026-09-09 during cross-file font-token audit, replacing the old flat font/size/17 vs font/size/20 split. See per-mode notes.
Bold Coastal: 20px / 400 / Noto Sans -- Confirmed live 2026-09-09 on ocregister.com and denverpost.com ("Latest Headlines" eyebrow).
Modern Earthy: 17px / 700 / Noto Sans -- UNCONFIRMED — no site in the current 6-site repertoire runs the Modern Earthy theme, so this value could not be live-checked. Placeholder copied from Measured Vibrant; verify against a real Modern Earthy production site before relying on it.
Measured Vibrant: 17px / 700 / Noto Sans -- Confirmed live 2026-09-09 on chicagotribune.com and orlandosentinel.com ("Latest Headlines" eyebrow).
Morning Call: 21px / 400 / Noto Serif -- Confirmed live 2026-09-09 on mcall.com ("Latest Headlines" eyebrow). canoncitydailyrecord.com measured identically (21/400/Noto Serif) but is not currently modeled under any theme mode in MNG Design System’s Brand collection — flagged separately.
Updated 2026-09-09 (Karl): Modern Earthy and Morning Call share identical typography (colors aside), so this now matches Morning Call's confirmed live value (21px / 400 / Noto Serif) instead of the earlier Measured Vibrant placeholder.
